headline: Thursday: Jaguars @ Ravens on Thursday Night Football (Baltimore down to its third-string QB), two NBA games (Magic @ Suns, Heat @ Warriors), and college basketball.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Wednesday these went 0-2. Today's plays all have two sources agreeing, though a third source disagrees on the NBA games.

straight.reasoning: Yahoo and WagerTalk both take the Under. Lamar Jackson is on IR and Tyler Huntley is out or doubtful, so undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano likely starts; he went 10-for-21 for 91 yards last week. Baltimore should lean on Derrick Henry and run the clock. Jacksonville has gone Under in four of its last five road games, and the total has already dropped from 42.5. Lines range from 39.5 to 40.5; playable to 39.5.

Covers and Deadspin both pick Golden State. The Warriors have won five straight, three by double digits, and haven't played since Monday. Miami played overtime last night before flying to the Bay Area, allows the fourth-most points in the league, and Giannis has a wrist injury. Dimers' model leans Miami, so it's half a unit. Skip at -8.5.

Covers and Deadspin both take Orlando. Phoenix has lost four straight, hasn't covered in six games, ranks 30th in defensive rating, and is on a back-to-back after allowing 132 to Portland. Orlando has two days of rest. Risk: Banchero is out. Dimers' model likes Phoenix, so it's half a unit. Skip below +1.

sections.label: NBA
sections.slate: Light NBA Thursday, two games: Magic @ Suns (6:00 PM PT) and Heat @ Warriors (7:00). Covers and Deadspin agree on both picks; Dimers' model takes the other side of both.

straight.reasoning: Five straight wins and rested, against a Miami team on a back-to-back after overtime. Skip at -8.5.
Phoenix is on a back-to-back, has lost four straight, and hasn't covered in six. Skip below +1.

sections.label: College Hoops
sections.slate: College basketball Thursday. No two sources agreed on a game, so these are quarter units.

straight.reasoning: VSiN expects a slow, 70-72 possession game, which limits how far Virginia Tech can pull away, and Mercer's offense has improved under Ryan Ridder.
McNeese has the stronger offense: 91st in KenPom adjusted efficiency, against North Texas at 275th last year. RotoWire's pick.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Thursday Night Football: Jaguars @ Ravens, 5:15 PM PT on Prime Video. Jacksonville -9.5 to -10, total 39.5-40.5. Baltimore is starting undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano at QB.

straight.reasoning: A third-string QB and a run-heavy game plan; two sources agree. Playable to 39.5.

WagerTalk projects Jacksonville by 7. Over 83% of the money is on the Jaguars, and a slow game helps the home underdog stay inside 10. Baltimore is 1-6 against the spread, which is why it's a quarter unit.

sections.slate: Season over. The Brewers are World Series champions.
